cause.statement: checkout-svc version 1.9.0 introduced a timeout bug in payment retry logic

parsed.rationale: The checkout-svc version 1.9.0 deployment (d-535) was followed by a spike in payment timeouts (log:aea2b46ce0) and checkout error rate (metric:83cc53b310). The commit e7a0cc0 (DEMO-9) specifically addresses payment retry timeouts, but the error logs show timeouts after 250ms, which aligns with the new retry policy. The payment-svc error rate (metric:5b57555878) shows high errors, but the checkout-svc error rate is the primary symptom. The evidence supports hypothesis-1 as the most direct cause.
